LanguageData.RP_BreakAskText:
Some of your inmates are planning a break, and this much is known:

{0}

Whatever else belongs to it is still hidden.

Foil it now - the guards frisk the crew you know of, search their cells and keep them apart. With this little evidence their cases go to the adjudication sheet as suspicion only, and the plan falls apart.
Let it run - the guards wait for the night. With the way out known a guard post goes up on it, manned {1}; a crew that comes out by a manned post is restrained and charged with an officer's evidence. Misjudge the night and they are gone, and only the count will tell you.
Turn the inside man - once an officer on the crew's payroll is known, he can be made to work for you, and tells you a link of the plan a day.
